title: Concord week objective ledger — Q3 2026 (draft)
content:
Purpose
---
Quick, scannable ledger to frame the Concord week (7-day alignment window) for execs and leads. This is intentionally terse — aim is to get commitments for 30/60/90-day slices and a lean all-hands agenda. Keep decisions lightweight; log open risks.

High-level framing (one-liners)
- Why now: Elevated demand pattern across hosted API; Dedicated contracts pipeline needs capacity guarantees; cross-team friction on rollout policy.
- Goal of Concord week: (1) land top 3 company objectives and measurable north-star deltas, (2) align leadership on resource and risk tradeoffs, (3) produce a short public-facing all-hands narrative.

Candidate company objectives (draft metrics)
1) Reduce p50 API latency by 15% for 99th-percentile production workload (target: p50 23ms -> 19.5ms) — owners: infra + serving-runtime.
2) Improve unit inference cost (hosted) by 12% through batching + KV cache tuning (target cost per 1k tokens drop) — owners: optimize + platform-eng.
3) Win two Dedicated commitments (>=$200k ARR each) with SLA upgrade path — owners: sales + product-dedicated.
4) Ship Private deployment pilot for Regulated Customer X with KMS/HSM integration in VPC (MVP: audit logs + perf baseline) — owners: private-deployments + security.

All-hands skeleton (30 min)
- 0-5m: CEO framing — why Concord week and single ask (focus).
- 5-12m: Product demo — measurable improvements + customer signal (showcase one Dedicated prospect).
- 12-20m: Engineering snapshot — top risks and the 15% latency plan (heatmap).
- 20-26m: Customer success highlight — pilot case study ask.
- 26-30m: Clear rally ask + where to sign up for followups (ownership and slack channels).

Exec update talking points (for leadership)
- Quick wins vs. bets: call out 2 low-effort, high-impact items (batching config and a small quantization rollout) and 1 bet requiring >$Xk.
- Risk register (top 5): capacity scarcity in west-2 region, rollout regression risk for decoder models, compliance gating for Private pilot.
- Ask: sign-off on 6-week runway for Dedicated capacity procurement (approx $420k) and prioritization of one SRE squad to support rollout.

Decisions to make this week
- Tighten objective 1 metric: do we measure p50 across all models or only verified catalog? (recommend: verified catalog for signal clarity).
- Prioritization of infra headcount (hire vs. contractor) for 60-day window.
- Customer-facing phrasing for Dedicated contract (remove technical caveats in sales docs).

Open questions / placeholders
- Exact cost model for caching-tier charges — finance needs a simple slab table.
- SLA language: what uptime target do we realistically promise for early Dedicated customers? Legal review pending.

Rough 30/60/90 cadence (who does what)
- 0–30 days: measurement baseline + two canary experiments (batching knobs; KV cache TTL change). Owners: infra, optimize.
- 31–60 days: roll to 10% of traffic if no regressions, closed-loop cost measurement, initiate Dedicated contract negotiations. Owners: platform-eng, sales.
- 61–90 days: Private pilot readiness checklist complete + ensure KMS integration and audit trail handoff. Owners: private-deployments, security, solutions-eng.

Comms and artifacts to produce by EOW
- One-slide CEO narrative (Asha)
- 2-slide infra heatmap + rollback plan (Diego)
- Customer pilot 1-pager + ask (Leah)
- Finance slab for cache charges (Elena)

Notes to self / friction points
- Keep OKR language simple — avoid long-running experiments in top-level objectives.
- Watch out for overlapping instrumentation: multiple teams want to add latency metrics; unify telem owners.
- Slack channel for Concord-week decisions: #concord-week-ops (create and invite execs).

Appendix (short)
- Quick refs: perf dashboard link (CONF-4281), Dedicated pipeline board (JIRA-OPS-1123).
- Meeting plan: Mon kickoff (exec 30m), Wed tactical triage (30m), Fri decision forum (60m).

Unresolved items to raise in Mon kickoff
- Final metric definitions (verified-catalog vs all-model sample).
- Budget approval threshold for Dedicated capacity procurement.
- Legal signoff timeline for Private pilot SLA.

——
Draft status and next step: circulate to leadership (Diego, Leah, Tomás) for comments 48h, lock final language for all-hands deck by Thu COB.
